class ZipTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.sources = syncer.collect_scripts(syncer.REPO_ROOT)

    def pack(self, scripts, target, dry_run=False):
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            syncer.pack_zip(scripts, target, dry_run)

    def test_catalog_defaults_and_explicit_selection(self):
        select = lambda **kwargs: syncer.select_zip_scripts(syncer.REPO_ROOT, self.sources, **kwargs)
        defaults = {name for name, _ in select()}
        self.assertIn("page-reader-markdown.user.js", defaults)
        self.assertTrue(defaults.isdisjoint({"hello-userscript.user.js", "page-title-tag.user.js", "m365-copilot-export-markdown.user.js", "dino-ai-lab.user.js"}))
        self.assertEqual(select(include_all=True), self.sources)
        self.assertEqual({name for name, _ in select(categories=["examples"])}, {"hello-userscript.user.js", "page-title-tag.user.js"})
        both = {name for name, _ in select(categories=["examples", "experimental", "examples"])}
        self.assertEqual(both, {"hello-userscript.user.js", "page-title-tag.user.js", "m365-copilot-export-markdown.user.js", "dino-ai-lab.user.js"})
        self.assertEqual([name for name, _ in select(only=["page-title-tag"])], ["page-title-tag.user.js"])
        for kwargs in ({"categories": ["typo"]}, {"only": ["typo"]}):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Unknown"):

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-19 04:14:42Z)**_

CI is passing again: run #50, with both `verify` and `vim-navigation` green.

**Cause:** One test kept failing in the `verify` job: `test_catalog_defaults_and_explicit_selection` in `tests/test_sync_userscripts.py`. It had a hardcoded list of the scripts in the `experimental` category, holding only `m365-copilot-export-markdown` and `dino-ai-lab`. When `chat-reply-assistant` was added to `experimental` in `scripts/catalog.json` (CI #42), the real list no longer matched the test's copy, and every run after that failed. The new `etherscan-tx-explainer` (#49) would have tripped the same check. The browser tests (`vim-navigation`) were passing the whole time.

**Fix:** The test now reads which scripts belong to each category directly from `scripts/catalog.json`. Adding a script to `experimental` no longer breaks it. It still checks the things that matter:
- The `examples` category contains exactly its two scripts.
- `experimental` still includes its two original scripts.
- The default package leaves out everything in `examples` and `experimental`.
- Choosing more than one category, or the same one twice, returns their combined scripts once each.

Locally, `check`, `index:check` and the sync unittests all passed before I pushed. I committed and pushed straight to `main` as `test(sync): derive catalog category members from catalog.json`.
